LetsEncryptDedupReport.description: What the removal of the duplicated let's encrypt certificates found, and deleted

dryRun.description: `true` when nothing was deleted, the report only says what would be

certificates.description: The number of let's encrypt certificates otoroshi holds

duplicates.description: The ids of the let's encrypt certificates that duplicate a certificate kept

expired.description: The ids of the expired let's encrypt certificates whose domains are covered by a certificate kept, when `deleteExpired` is true

deleted.description: The number of certificates deleted, 0 for a dry run
